questions.text: Which regions get their own queue at launch?
questions.context: The routing story needs a region list before it can be estimated.

questions.text: Does the duplicate check include closed requests from the last week?
questions.context: Site contacts sometimes reopen a problem the day after a visit.

answer.label: Proposed answer
answer.text: Only open requests count; a closed request never blocks a new one.

questions.text: How long is a standard visit slot?
questions.context: The calendar needs one slot length for booking.

answer.label: Answer
answer.text: Two hours, with a 30-minute travel buffer.

questions.text: Should booking wait for a parts check?
questions.context: The parts check ticket was canceled, so booking does not check stock.

questions.text: Are photos required to close a visit?
questions.context: The closeout ticket now mentions photos, and storage limits are unknown.
